title: Independence of the integral representative
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field, $X,Y$ finite-type $K_0$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible in $K_0$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $\mathcal C_W=D^b_c(W,R)$ be the derived-complete integral category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and let $Q_W:\mathcal C_W\to\mathcal C_W[1/\varpi]=D^b_c(W,E)$ be its raw scalar localization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-weil-linear-scalar-localization]. For any $K,K'\in\mathcal C_X$ and any specified isomorphism $\alpha:Q_XK\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_XK'$, the two rational compact-support images
$$
Q_Y(Rf_!K)=(Rf_!K)\otimes_R^L E,\qquad
Q_Y(Rf_!K')=(Rf_!K')\otimes_R^L E
$$
of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], interpreted using the coherent tower of [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor], have an induced isomorphism $\beta_\alpha:Q_Y(Rf_!K)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_Y(Rf_!K')$, functorial in $\alpha$. It sends identities to identities and compositions to compositions. Equivalently, for specified presentations $a:Q_XK\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ and $a':Q_XK'\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ of a common rational object, the canonical comparison is $\beta_{(a')^{-1}a}$. The word canonical refers to these specified identifications, not to a choice-independent isomorphism between bare isomorphism classes.

proof.text: Choose one compactification using its existence theorem and a small site in the stated coefficient universes. The coherent reduction-tower theorem gives the exact $R$-linear functor $T=\mathcal T_f^c$, including its evaluation isomorphisms and quotient transitions. The strict-tower limit theorem supplies the exact functor $L=R\lim$, computed by resolving the entire tower. Its Roos triangle identifies $LT(K)$ with the integral compact-support derived-limit formula, without choosing cones functorially.

source.place: Proof first sentence: coherent exact tower and total inverse limit.

proof.text: Constant sections act on $\mathcal A_Y=\operatorname{Mod}(B_Y)$, $B_Y=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ [lem-weil-integral-constructible-linear], and componentwise on the abelian category $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A_Y)$ [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian], commuting with the module-map transitions; derived localizations inherit this [lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category]. On compatible families $\lim(au)=a\lim(u)$ and $\lim(u+v)=\lim(u)+\lim(v)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], tower complexes have K-injective resolutions and $L=R\lim$ is the total right derived functor of termwise $\lim$, computed on them. So [lem-weil-kinjective-total-derived-linear] applies with $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A_Y)$, $\mathcal B=\mathcal A_Y$, $U=\lim$: $L$ is additive and $R$-linear, hence so is $LT$ ($T$ is $R$-linear by [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor]). No linear choice of resolutions is required.

source.place: Proof first sentence: apply the extracted K-injective linearity theorem to ordinary inverse limit.

proof.text: The integral compact-support constructibility theorem applies with the same field, invertible prime, coefficient field, compactification and transitions. Every such derived limit lies in $\mathcal C_Y$, with the asserted uniform cohomological interval. Thus $LT$ restricts to $F:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal C_Y$. Fullness and the inherited triangulated and linear structures preserve exactness and linearity. Its values are $Rf_!K$ by the compact-support definition.

source.place: Proof first sentence: constructibility and restriction to the full integral category.
Rational-transport sentence: tensor balancing, identity, composition, and uniqueness.

proof.text: Set $\beta_\alpha=F_E(\alpha)$, with inverse $F_E(\alpha^{-1})$: the two composites are images of identities. Its objects are the displayed rational compact-support values by definition. Functor laws give $\beta_1=1$ and $\beta_{\alpha'\alpha}=\beta_{\alpha'}\beta_\alpha$. Presentations $a,a'$ give $\beta_{(a')^{-1}a}$; for a third, $(a'')^{-1}a'\,(a')^{-1}a=(a'')^{-1}a$, proving the cocycle. Each changed presentation has its own relative comparison.

source.place: Final sentence: comparison, inverse, identity, composition, and presentation cocycle.

split_report.summary: Human-requested re-split: keep the statement and all imported and Lean records unchanged. Extract the substantial K-injective representative argument as lem-weil-kinjective-total-derived-linear, a statement-only generic lemma without an exactness assumption on the underived functor. Retain compactification, coherent tower, total-limit comparison, constructibility, tensor balancing, extension uniqueness, and comparison inverse/cocycle in the parent assembly. Source and duplicate checks and full extracted argument are in report.md.
split_report.blueprint: The new lemma carries the K-injective Hom comparison, conjugation, additivity, scalar-linearity, homotopy descent, and independence from linear choices used by the first proof sentence. Parent Steps 1-3 assemble its integral exact linear functor; Steps 4-5 retain every rational tensor and comparison calculation of the original route.
